main.method: Original-figure hybrid-pi test-source KCL for Q3, then symmetric common-mode half-circuit with VA1=VA2=infinity and negligible Q1/Q2 base currents; symbolic identities checked in SymPy.
main.conclusion: A_CM-DM = |DeltaRc|/[1/gm + 2*(1+gm3*(R1||rpi3))*ro3] under stated added approximations. Exact tail resistance is ro3+(1+gm3*ro3)*(R1||rpi3).
main.evidence: independent-sympy.py executed successfully; independent-result.txt contains KCL, exact resistance, approximation error, finite-beta correction and limits. Original only states VA1=VA2=infinity; large beta and ro3 >> R1||rpi3 must be disclosed.
